name: seceon-siem
label: Seceon SIEM
description: Seceon SIEM provides integrations that allow you to retrieve alerts and close alerts with notes.

fields.title: Server URL
fields.description: Specify the base URL of the Seceon SIEM server.
fields.tooltip: Specify the base URL of the Seceon SIEM server.
fields.name: serverURL

fields.title: API Token
fields.tooltip: Specify the Seceon SIEM API key used to authenticate API requests.
fields.description: Specify the Seceon SIEM API key used to authenticate API requests.
fields.name: aPIToken

fields.title: Tenant ID
fields.description: Specify the default tenant ID to use for API calls. This parameter is required when using a Global Auth Key covering multiple tenants. Optional when using a tenant-specify auth key.
fields.name: tenantID
fields.tooltip: Specify the default tenant ID to use for API calls. This parameter is required when using a Global Auth Key covering multiple tenants. Optional when using a tenant-specify auth key.

fields.title: Verify SSL
fields.description: Specifies whether the SSL certificate for the server is to be verified or not. By default, this option is set as True.
fields.tooltip: Specifies whether the SSL certificate for the server is to be verified or not. By default, this option is set as True.
fields.name: verifySSL

operations.title: Get All Alerts
operations.description: Retrieves alerts from Seceon OTM based on one or more filter criteria.

parameters.title: Alert Type
parameters.description: (Optional) Select one or more alert categories to filter the results. Supported values are Brute Force Attack, Malware Infected Host, and Policy Violation.
parameters.name: alertType
parameters.tooltip: Select one or more alert categories to filter the results. Supported values are Brute Force Attack, Malware Infected Host, and Policy Violation.

parameters.title: Alert Severity
parameters.description: (Optional) Select one or more severity levels to filter the results. Supported values are CRITICAL, MAJOR, and MINOR.
parameters.name: alertSeverity
parameters.tooltip: Select one or more severity levels to filter the results. Supported values are CRITICAL, MAJOR, and MINOR.

parameters.title: Alert Status
parameters.description: (Optional) Select one or more alert statuses to filter the results. Supported values are OPEN and CLOSED.
parameters.name: alertStatus
parameters.tooltip: Select one or more alert statuses to filter the results. Supported values are OPEN and CLOSED.

parameters.title: Confidence Score Range
parameters.description: (Optional) Specify a confidence score range between 0 and 100 to filter alerts based on the system's confidence in the identified threat.
parameters.name: confidenceScoreRange
parameters.tooltip: Specify a confidence score range between 0 and 100 to filter alerts based on the system's confidence in the identified threat. Example: {"from": 50, "to": 75}

parameters.title: Assigned To
parameters.description: (Optional) Specify a comma-separated list of user email addresses to retrieve alerts assigned to those users.
parameters.name: assignedTo
parameters.tooltip: Specify a comma-separated list of user email addresses to retrieve alerts assigned to those users. Example: ["abc@example.com", "xyz@domain.com"] or abc@example.com, xyz@domain.com

parameters.title: Username
parameters.description: (Optional) Specify a comma-separated list of usernames to filter alerts by associated users.
parameters.name: username
parameters.tooltip: Specify a comma-separated list of usernames to filter alerts by associated users. Example: ["USER1", "USER2"] or USER1, USER2

parameters.title: Create Time Range
parameters.description: (Optional) Specify a date and time range to retrieve alerts created during that period.
parameters.name: createTimeRange
parameters.tooltip: Specify a date and time range to retrieve alerts created during that period. Example: {"from": "2019-02-08T17:32:28.000Z", "to": "2019-02-08T17:32:28.000Z"}

parameters.title: Update Time Range
parameters.description: (Optional) Specify a date and time range to retrieve alerts updated during that period.
parameters.name: updateTimeRange
parameters.tooltip: Specify a date and time range to retrieve alerts updated during that period. Example: {"from": "2019-02-08T17:32:28.000Z", "to": "2019-02-08T17:32:28.000Z"}

parameters.title: Page Size
parameters.description: (Optional) Specify the number of alerts to retrieve per page.
parameters.name: pageSize
parameters.tooltip: Specify the number of alerts to retrieve per page.

parameters.title: Scroll ID
parameters.description: (Optional) Specify the scroll ID returned by a previous alert retrieval response to retrieve the next page of results. When you provide a scroll ID, the action ignores all other filter parameters. Each scroll context remains active for 5 minutes.
parameters.name: scrollID
parameters.tooltip: Specify the scroll ID returned by a previous alert retrieval response to retrieve the next page of results. When you provide a scroll ID, the action ignores all other filter parameters. Each scroll context remains active for 5 minutes.

parameters.title: Tenant ID
parameters.description: (Optional) Override the tenant ID configured in the connector for this action. This parameter is required when using a Global Auth Key.
parameters.name: tenantID
parameters.tooltip: Override the tenant ID configured in the connector for this action. This parameter is required when using a Global Auth Key.

operations.title: Close Alert
operations.description: Closes an alert by setting its status to CLOSED. You can optionally provide closure notes to document the investigation outcome for auditing and compliance purposes.

parameters.title: Alert ID
parameters.description: Specify the unique Seceon OTM alert ID of the alert you want to close.
parameters.name: alertID
parameters.tooltip: Specify the unique Seceon OTM alert ID of the alert you want to close.

parameters.title: Closure Notes
parameters.description: (Optional) Specify notes explaining the reason for closing the alert.
parameters.name: closureNotes
parameters.tooltip: Specify notes explaining the reason for closing the alert.

parameters.title: Performed By
parameters.description: (Optional) Specify the email address of the analyst or system performing the closure action.
parameters.name: performedBy
parameters.tooltip: Specify the email address of the analyst or system performing the closure action.

parameters.title: Is Enforced
parameters.description: (Optional) Enable this option to instruct Seceon OTM to treat the provided information as authoritative and skip additional validation checks. By default, this option is Disabled.
parameters.name: isEnforced
parameters.tooltip: Enable this option to instruct Seceon OTM to treat the provided information as authoritative and skip additional validation checks. By default, this option is Disabled.

parameters.title: Tenant ID
parameters.description: (Optional) Override the tenant ID configured in the connector for this action. This parameter is required when using a Global Auth Key.
parameters.name: tenantID
parameters.tooltip: Override the tenant ID configured in the connector for this action. This parameter is required when using a Global Auth Key.

operations.title: Search Threat Indicator Alert
operations.description: Retrieves the threat indicators (evidence) associated with a specific alert. These indicators represent the underlying suspicious events that triggered to the alert.

parameters.title: Alert ID
parameters.description: Specify the unique Seceon OTM alert ID for which you want to retrieve threat indicators.
parameters.name: alertID
parameters.tooltip: Specify the unique Seceon OTM alert ID for which you want to retrieve threat indicators.

parameters.title: Source IPs
parameters.description: (Optional) Specify a comma-separated list of source IP addresses to filter the threat indicators.
parameters.name: sourceIP
parameters.tooltip: Specify a comma-separated list of source IP addresses to filter the threat indicators. Example: ["10.10.10.100", "192.168.19.100"] or 10.10.10.100, 192.168.19.100

parameters.title: Destination IPs
parameters.description: (Optional) Specify a comma-separated list of destination IP addresses to filter the threat indicators.
parameters.name: destinationIP
parameters.tooltip: Specify a comma-separated list of destination IP addresses to filter the threat indicators. Example: ["10.11.12.150", "192.168.19.3"] or 10.11.12.150, 192.168.19.3

parameters.title: Event Origin
parameters.description: (Optional) Specify a comma-separated list of event origins to filter the threat indicators.
parameters.name: eventOrigin
parameters.tooltip: Specify a comma-separated list of event origins to filter the threat indicators. Example: ["Network", "Machine Learning"] or Network, Machine Learning
parameters.placeholder: For e.g ["Network", "Machine Learning"] or Network, Machine Learning

parameters.title: Event Type Name
parameters.description: (Optional) Specify a comma-separated list of event type names to filter the threat indicators.
parameters.name: eventTypeName
parameters.tooltip: Specify a comma-separated list of event type names to filter the threat indicators. Example: ["Data Upload", "New Connection"] or Data Upload, New Connection
parameters.placeholder: For e.g ["Data Upload", "New Connection"] or Data Upload, New Connection

parameters.title: Source Data Type
parameters.description: (Optional) Specify a comma-separated list of source data types to filter the threat indicators.
parameters.name: sourceDataType
parameters.tooltip: Specify a comma-separated list of source data types to filter the threat indicators. Example: ["netflow", "Linux"] or netflow, Linux

parameters.title: Username
parameters.description: (Optional) Specify a comma-separated list of usernames to filter the threat indicators.
parameters.name: userName
parameters.tooltip: Specify a comma-separated list of usernames to filter the threat indicators. Example: ["USER1", "USER2"] or USER1, USER2

parameters.title: Timestamp Range
parameters.description: (Optional) Specify a timestamp range to filter the threat indicators.
parameters.name: timestampRange
parameters.tooltip: Specify a timestamp range to filter the threat indicators. Example: {"from": "2024-01-01T00:00:00.000Z", "to": "2024-01-31T23:59:59.000Z"}

parameters.title: Page Size
parameters.description: (Optional) Specify the number of threat indicators to retrieve per page. The minimum is 10, the maximum is 500, and the default is 20.
parameters.name: pageSize
parameters.tooltip: Specify the number of threat indicators to retrieve per page. The minimum is 10, the maximum is 500, and the default is 20.

parameters.title: Scroll ID
parameters.description: (Optional) Specify the scroll ID returned by a previous threat indicator retrieval response to retrieve the next page of results. When you provide a scroll ID, the action ignores all other filter parameters. Each scroll context remains active for 5 minutes.
parameters.name: scrollID
parameters.tooltip: Specify the scroll ID returned by a previous threat indicator retrieval response to retrieve the next page of results. When you provide a scroll ID, the action ignores all other filter parameters. Each scroll context remains active for 5 minutes.

parameters.title: Tenant ID
parameters.description: (Optional) Override the tenant ID configured in the connector for this action. This parameter is required when using a Global Auth Key.
parameters.name: tenantID
parameters.tooltip: Override the tenant ID configured in the connector for this action. This parameter is required when using a Global Auth Key.

operations.title: Execute API Request
operations.description: Sends a custom HTTP request to the Seceon OTM REST API. Use this action to access API endpoints that are not available through dedicated connector actions. The connector automatically applies the configured tenant ID. You can override it using the Tenant ID input parameter.

parameters.title: HTTP Method
parameters.description: Select the HTTP method to use for the API request. Supported values are GET, POST, PUT, DELETE, and PATCH.
parameters.name: method
parameters.tooltip: Select the HTTP method to use for the API request. Supported values are GET, POST, PUT, DELETE, and PATCH.

parameters.title: Endpoint
parameters.description: Specify the API endpoint path. The path must begin with a forward slash (/).
parameters.name: endpoint
parameters.tooltip: Specify the API endpoint path. The path must begin with a forward slash (/). Example: /api/v1/alert/search

parameters.title: Query Parameters
parameters.description: (Optional) Specify a JSON object containing query string parameters to append to the request URL.
parameters.name: queryParams
parameters.tooltip: Specify a JSON object containing query string parameters to append to the request URL. Example: {"size": 50}

parameters.title: Request Body
parameters.description: (Optional) Specify a JSON request body for POST, PUT, or PATCH requests.
parameters.name: requestBody
parameters.tooltip: Specify a JSON request body for POST, PUT, or PATCH requests. Example: {"alert_type": "Brute Force Attack"}

parameters.title: Tenant ID
parameters.description: Override the tenant ID configured in the connector for this action. This parameter is required when using a Global Auth Key.
parameters.name: tenantID
parameters.tooltip: Override the tenant ID configured in the connector for this action. This parameter is required when using a Global Auth Key.
